description: Show your passport, how strong this sign-in is (credential), balance (owner.balance_expires_at: when it expires without a top-up or purchase; tell your human in time), starter credit (owner.starter_credit: what is left of the free start's credit and until when; buy spends it first, even at a balance of 0, on a new utility or code kit it covers in full; starter_status shows the free start itself), spend limit, notices, pending reviews, and at most one optional question from us (answer it once with send_feedback and its prompt_id). owner.email_hint (who paid, masked) and owner.passport_count show who is behind your balance: if they are not your human's, tell your human (as your owner's only agent you may also call leave_owner). owner.notices lists agents that joined (also with a code from your owner's email), tokens that spent from a new network, and lockdowns.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: whoami
title: Show my passport and balance
